blurb.bm: Rumah persatuan keluarga dengan seni bina yang sangat halus di Cannon Square.
blurb.en: A clanhouse with intricate architecture in Cannon Square.

ask.bm: Khoo Kongsi ialah rumah persatuan untuk keluarga bernama…
ask.en: Khoo Kongsi is the clanhouse of families named…

why.bm: Betul! Nama penuhnya Leong San Tong Khoo Kongsi.
why.en: Right! Its full name is Leong San Tong Khoo Kongsi.

items.en: 1901 · Burned down, said to be lightning

intro.bm: Leong San Tong Khoo Kongsi ialah rumah persatuan keluarga Khoo, dan disebut rumah kongsi Hokkien terbesar di Malaysia.
intro.en: Leong San Tong Khoo Kongsi is the clanhouse of the Khoo families, described as the largest Hokkien clanhouse in Malaysia.

bm: Nenek moyang keluarga Khoo berasal dari wilayah Fujian, China.
Rumah kongsi pertama dibina pada 1851. Ia terbakar pada 1901, dikatakan dipanah petir.
Versi yang lebih kecil dibina semula dari 1902 dan siap pada 1906.
en: The Khoo ancestors came from Fujian province, China.
The first clanhouse was built in 1851. It burned down in 1901, reportedly struck by lightning.
A smaller version was rebuilt from 1902 and completed in 1906.

bm: Ukiran dan rasuk kayu yang sangat halus
Dataran granit dikelilingi rumah kedai lama
en: Very fine carvings and wooden beams
The granite square ringed by old rowhouses

fun.bm: Opera Cina masih dipentaskan di sini pada bulan ketujuh kalendar lunar.
fun.en: Chinese operas are still staged here during the seventh lunar month.
